title.zh: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
title.en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push

current_state.zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin，后者将作为独立业务部门运营；财务条款未披露。
current_state.en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire OpenZeppelin, which will operate as a standalone business unit; financial terms were not disclosed.

updates.title_zh: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
updates.title_en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
updates.what_changed_zh: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.
updates.what_changed_en: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.

updates.title_zh: S&P Global agrees to acquire OpenZeppelin in onchain security push
updates.title_en: S&P Global agrees to acquire OpenZeppelin in onchain security push
updates.what_changed_zh: 该交易是收购协议而非已完成收购，OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 的独立业务部门运营，财务条款未披露。
updates.what_changed_en: The deal is an agreement to acquire rather than a completed acquisition, and OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit under S&P Global; financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.current_state_zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin，后者将作为独立业务部门运营；财务条款未披露。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, which will operate as a standalone business unit, marking a notable traditional finance push into onchain security infrastructure.
